name: Osaka Castle
description: One of Japan's most famous landmarks. The main tower houses a museum on Toyotomi Hideyoshi. The surrounding park is famous for cherry blossoms.

name: Dotonbori
description: Osaka's most iconic entertainment district. Famous for neon signs, the Glico Running Man, street food, and canal cruises. The heart of Osaka's kuidaore (eat till you drop) culture.

name: Kani Doraku Dotonbori
description: Historic crab restaurant famous for its giant moving crab sign. Offers teppanyaki, hot pots, and all-you-can-eat crab courses.

name: Daruma Kushikatsu
description: The birthplace of kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers). Famous for their no-double-dipping sauce rule. Casual, standing-room vibe.

name: Tenjin Matsuri
description: One of Japan's top 3 festivals. Held every July 24-25. Features a massive boat procession, fireworks, and traditional music along the Okawa River.

name: Osaka Amazing Pass
description: A tourist pass offering free entry to 40+ attractions and unlimited subway/bus rides for 1 or 2 days. Highly recommended for first-time visitors.
